－－－－－ Important －－－－－
Read first this manual before operate this controller. In some case, failure to follow the instructions manual can lead
to control or machine damage. In other cases failure to follow instructions can lead to injury, or death of personnel.
This manual explains some instructions depends on the level of danger as follows.
DANGER
It shows readers where people will be hurt if procedures are not followed properly.
WARNING
It shows readers where people may be hurt if procedures are not followed properly.
CAUTION
It shows readers where machinery may be damaged or economic loss can occur, or
people may be hurt if procedures are not followed properly.
RISK OF ELECTRIC SHOCK
It shows readers where people will be struck by an electric shock if procedures are not
followed properly.
READ FIRST
To use this controller in safety, the operator should follow industry standards and safety senses whenever working on,
or near the weld machine.
In some case, failure to follow the warning instructions can lead to control or machine damage. In other cases failure to
follow these instructions can lead to injury, or death of personnel.
Some examples of safe practices are listed below. These examples are not to be considered a comprehensive listing
of safety practices. Always use safety senses when working with any type of machinery.
DANGER
1. This controller is charged with hazardous voltage electricity. Turn electrical power OFF before open the door and
confirm discharging large capacitors if the door is opened. In the case the door is opened as it is not turn OFF can
lead to injury by an electric shock, or death of personnel.
2. In the case of inverter welding controller
This controller is installed capacitors, and hazardous voltage staying there even if electrical power OFF. Turn
electrical power OFF first, and ensure discharge the power supply capacitors before working on any electrical
circuit. In some case, failure to follow this instruction can lead to injury, or death of personnel.
A charge state can be confirmed with charge lamp inside the controller (Red lamp near timer unit.).
If power OFF, discharge will be started and charge lamp went out. Please check charge lamp is OFF.
But, carry out confirming safe conditions without depending only on charge lamp by using spark-testing
screwdriver.

WARNING
In some case failure to follow these instructions as follows can lead to control damage or injury of personnel.
1. Ensure that control/machine is connected to the correct voltage before turning electrical power ON.
2. Whenever power is ON, stand clear of moving parts. This practice should be used even if the machine is not actually
in use.
3. Before turning electrical power OFF, ensure that personnel are standing clear of moving parts that are pneumatic or
hydraulic powered.
4. Whenever electrical power is turned OFF, install a "lock-out" device at the main disconnect to prevent power from
being accidentally turned ON.
5. The cautions at the time of a breaker trip (only inverter welding controller)
When a breaker trip occurs, check the following items.
(a) Internal leak of the welding transformer
(b) Ground accident by wear and tear of the primary cable
(c) Secondary diode break of the welding transformer
(d) Short circuit of the primary cable
Welding controller may be damaged when the above-mentioned item corresponds. In this case, both the timer
unit and the transistor in contactor will be damaged.
So, do not use the timer unit and contactor that had the breaker trip and ask to repair those to manufacture.
CAUTION
1. Turn electrical power OFF before changing the tap switch at the weld transformer.
In the case failure to follow the instruction like a welding at changing the tap switch can lead to injury to personnel.
2. Turn stop cock OFF before some piping work.
In the case failure to follow the instruction like the electrical circuit is splashed with cooling water can lead to
control damage.

CAUTION
MEMORY DATA ERROR
This controller preserves the setting data in the flash memory (nonvolatile memory). Time of a few seconds is
necessary for writing data in the flash memory because of the characteristic of the device.
Therefore, if the power supply is turned off immediately after data writing, the writing might not be finished properly.
In the case, memory data fault or parameter data fault might be detected.
Moreover, if super capacitor to backup the memory is degraded, memory data fault might occur because backup time
is not enough.
Therefore, please notice the following items.
1. Never turn off the power supply FOR 15 SECONDS or more after the data setting to the
timer.
2. If timer detects MEMORY DATA ERROR by any chance, please INITIALIZE the data and set all data
again.
3. If memory data fault occur frequently, contact our company. Backup capacitor might be degraded.
CAUTION
SUMMARY OF POWER-OFF
This controller preserves the setting data in the flash memory (nonvolatile memory). Time of a few seconds is
necessary for writing data in the flash memory because of the characteristic of the device.
“Memory not update” fault may be occurred because of incorrect data written if power supply is turned off
immediately after weld is finished.
Therefore, please notice the following items.
1. Never turn off the power supply FOR 15 SECONDS or more after the data setting to the
timer.

CAUTION
SUMMARY OF COOLING WATER
Even if the controller is used in the range of specification environment, dew condensation damage caused by the low
temperature of cooling water occur depending on the environment of cooling water (Temperature / Humidity) and
conditions.
Please grasp the relation between environment and cooling water when the controller is especially use on condition
of the following. And do not generate dew condensation.
If there is question of about the possibility of dew condensation generating, please contact us beforehand.
1. Using controller in heat-and-high-humidity area.
2. Temperature management of cooling water by chiller etc.
3. Using groundwater for cooling water.
CAUTION
SUMMARY OF PRESSURE OF COOLING WATER
Water leak damage may occur from inside of the controller hose joint portion etc. when the range of the pressure of
cooling water decided by specification of the controller is exceeded.
Therefore, please notice the following items.
1. Please perform water pressure adjustment at outside of the controller by using reducing valve
etc. in consideration of product specification when water pressure is high.

CAUTION
SUMMARY OF INSTANTANEOUS POWER FAILURE
In this controller, automatic recognition of local frequency (50Hz/60Hz) is performed from power supply frequency.
Local frequency is again recognized automatically after power supply restored, if an instantaneous power failure occur
by thunderbolt etc. when using this controller.
But local frequency may not be recognized correctly, if automatic recognition is performed in a situation with unstable
power supply frequency.
Therefore, please notice the following items.
1. When instantaneous power failure occurs by thunderbolt etc., there is a possibility of
incorrect power supply frequency recognizing.
Please compare settled weld time and actual weld time by using weld current meter etc.
And please check that values do not differ.
2. If the above weld time differs, power supply must be rebooted after welding power supply
frequency is stabilized.
Please compare again and confirm same.
CAUTION
SUMMARY OF I/O SIGNAL (INTERFACE)
In the controller, some interface can be selected depending on the products.
I/O(Input and output) is not operated if "INTERFACE SELECTION" set by the controller and actually used interface is
different.
In this case, please notice the following items.
1. Please set “INTERFACE SELECTION” with actually used interface if that value and actually
used interface is different.
2. Settled “INTERFACE SELECTION” is available by rebooting of power supply.
Please reboot power supply after setup.
3. Even if there are unintentional configuration changes, settled “INTERFACE SELECTION”
will be changed by rebooting of power supply. And input and output is stopped.
4. “E91: OPTION FAULT” are detected when invalid interface is selected.

3-4. Discrete Input signal
(1) Transformer thermostat input
This input is for judgment the transformer thermostat. On condition is normal, OFF condition is failure.
If the dip switch (SW1-3) is ON, fault is never output regardless of this setting.
(2) Ready input
This input is for connecting welding transformer and this controller.
If you turn ON, timer can run sequence.
If this input turns OFF, the welding transformer is disconnected from this controller.
Way of input this signal differ with Setting of ”Safety ready VALID (category 4) or INVALID (category 2).
Refer to “13. Magnetic Contactor Operation” for detail.

3-5. Discrete Output signal
(1) MC on output
This output is for condition of Magnetic Contactor.
Logic of this signal is changed by setting of “Safety unit VALID / INVALID”.
(Safety relay VALID: b contact, Safety relay INVALID: a contact)
Refer to “13. Magnetic Contactor Operation” for detail.
3-6. EtherNet/IP Iutput signal
(1) Pilot input
Trigger input for current control.
Current controlled by current command input signal. Current command input signal should be input after pilot
input signal.
Note) Pilot input should be turned on more than 20 msec before current command input.
If current command input signal is turned on before pilot input signal, operation can not be guaranteed.
Note) If current command input signal does not turn on more than 1670 msec ( about 100cyc ) after this input
turns on, Error is detected. Also, even if current command input signal falls below the threshold, an error
is detected.
Note) Current command input signal should be turned off before pilot input signal is turned off.
When this input is turned off while current command input signal is ON, weld is interrupted. However, it
takes several seconds to weld interruption for processing of signal chattering removal by analog control.
(2) Weld / No weld input
This input is for changing weld operation and test operation. When this input is on, timer can weld. When this
input is off, timer can run the sequence with no weld.
If the dip switch (SW1-4) setting is ON, always weld mode regardless of this setting.
* This input should be turned on more than 20 msec before current command input.
(3) Fault reset input
This input is for reset the fault. If this is ON, fault output is reset and ready to next weld.
This signal is ignored during the weld sequence.

This is an input signal that switches the current range with analog control.

Also, this signal is ignored during the sequence.

(6) Input switch input
This is an input signal for switching analog or digital control by current command.
When this input signal is OFF, it is analog control. And analog Inout/Output is valid.

* This input should be turned on more than 20 msec before current command input.
Also, this signal is ignored during the sequence.

Please set the ratio of the primary and secondary windings of the weld transformer by binary.
Turns ratio is input in 0.1 step.

* This input should be turned on more than 20 msec before current command input.
Also, this signal is ignored during the sequence.

Please set secondary current value by binary. Current command is input in 1A step.
The setting range is 0 to 52000A. When the setting exceeds 52000A, “current program failure” is detected.
* This input is valid when input switch of input signal is turned on.
* If current command input is less than 1.5kA, this input is regarded as “0”.
* Please set the current for welding to 2.0 kA or more.
